title: Refactor database connection pooling
author: bob
description: Improves database connection efficiency by implementing connection pooling with configurable pool size. Fixes connection leak issues in high-load scenarios.

files.patch:
--- a/src/db/connection_pool.py
+++ b/src/db/connection_pool.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+from queue import Queue
+import psycopg2
+
+class ConnectionPool:
+    def __init__(self, pool_size: int = 5, db_config: dict = None):
+        self.pool_size = pool_size
+        self.db_config = db_config or {}
+        self.pool = Queue(maxsize=pool_size)
+        self._initialize_pool()
+    
+    def _initialize_pool(self):
+        for _ in range(self.pool_size):
+            conn = psycopg2.connect(**self.db_config)
+            self.pool.put(conn)
+    
+    def get_connection(self):
+        return self.pool.get(timeout=5)
+    
+    def return_connection(self, conn):
+        self.pool.put(conn)
+    
+    def close_all(self):
+        while not self.pool.empty():
+            conn = self.pool.get_nowait()
+            conn.close()

--- a/tests/test_connection_pool.py
+++ b/tests/test_connection_pool.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import pytest
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+from src.db.connection_pool import ConnectionPool
+
+@patch('psycopg2.connect')
+def test_pool_initialization(mock_connect):
+    pool = ConnectionPool(pool_size=3)
+    assert mock_connect.call_count == 3
+
+def test_get_return_connection():
+    mock_conn = Mock()
+    pool = ConnectionPool(pool_size=1)
+    pool.pool.put(mock_conn)
+    conn = pool.get_connection()
+    assert conn == mock_conn
